福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・安平區

散步補給站｜安平百年老味Refuel Stops: Century-Old Flavors

補給時間到！來嚐嚐安平的百年老味。林永泰興蜜餞行 1886 年創立於延平街，五代人守著這間老舖。老木櫃裡是鹹、酸、甜的蜜餞。買之前可以先試吃！同記安平豆花是安平豆花的老字號：鹽滷豆花，配紅豆或檸檬。創始人當年是挑著擔子沿街叫賣起家的。周氏蝦捲 1965 年創立，是辦桌總舖師起家的名店。酥皮裡包著近海的火燒蝦，是安平最具代表性的伴手味。文章牛肉湯要一早來：溫體牛肉切得極薄，滾湯一沖、半熟上桌。想坐下來好好吃一頓：府城食府的必比登台菜，記得先訂位！

Time to refuel! Let's taste the century-old flavors of Anping. Lin Yong-tai-xing Preserved Fruits opened in 1886 on Yanping Street. Five generations of one family have run it. Sweet, sour and salty candied fruits sit in old wooden cabinets. Ask for a taste before buying! Tong-ji Douhua is Anping's old-guard tofu-pudding house: silky, brine-set douhua under red beans or lemon. Its founder began by carrying his wares on a shoulder pole. Chou's Shrimp Rolls, founded in 1965, was born from a banquet chef's kitchen. The crisp rolls are packed with the little fire-roasted shrimp of the nearby coast. They are Anping's signature take-home dish. For Wen-chang Beef Soup, come at dawn. Paper-thin slices of never-refrigerated beef are scalded half-done in hot broth at your table. For a proper sit-down dinner, Fu-cheng Restaurant serves a Taiwanese banquet. Book ahead!

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

安平是府城最早的港口，也留下許多百年老味：五代相傳的蜜餞行、挑擔起家的豆花、辦桌師傅的蝦捲，還有一早就要來的牛肉湯。逛完古蹟，正好用味道認識安平。

Anping, the city's oldest port, keeps many century-old flavors: a candied-fruit shop run by five generations, tofu pudding first sold from a shoulder pole, shrimp rolls from a banquet chef, and beef soup for breakfast.

  1. 1886林永泰興蜜餞行在延平街創立。The Lin Yong Tai Xing candied-fruit shop opens on Yanping Street.
  2. 1965周氏蝦捲創立。Chou's Shrimp Rolls opens.
  3. 今天 Today安平豆花、蝦捲、蜜餞都是代表性的伴手味。Tofu pudding, shrimp rolls and candied fruit are Anping's classic food gifts.

認識景點

About the place

蜜餞：鹹、酸、甜的醃漬水果；林永泰興從 1886 年賣到現在。 甜、酸、鹹：安平老蜜餞的三種味道。 五代：一家人五代傳承，守著同一間店。 豆花：用豆漿和鹽滷做成，軟嫩滑順。

candied fruit: Sweet, sour and salty preserved fruit. Lin Yong-tai-xing has sold it since 1886. sweet, sour and salty: The three tastes of Anping's old candied fruit. five generations: Great-great-grandparents to children: one family running one shop. tofu pudding: Douhua: soft, silky pudding made from soy milk and brine.

紅豆：放在豆花上的甜紅豆。 檸檬：讓豆花多了清爽的酸味。 扁擔：放在肩上的長竿，兩頭掛著貨物。 蝦捲：包著蝦子的酥炸捲，安平的招牌。

red beans: Sweet red beans on top of douhua. lemon: Lemon gives douhua a fresh, sour taste. shoulder pole: A long pole carried on one shoulder, with a load at each end. shrimp roll: A crisp, fried roll filled with shrimp. Anping's signature dish.

火燒蝦：附近海岸產的紅色小蝦。 外帶伴手的名菜：買回家送給家人朋友的美食。 牛肉湯：在台南，牛肉湯是早餐，要一早來！ 薄如紙：像紙一樣薄；牛肉就切這麼薄。

fire-roasted shrimp: Little red shrimp from the nearby coast. take-home dish: Food you buy to bring home for family and friends. beef soup: In Tainan, beef soup is a breakfast food. Come at dawn! paper-thin: As thin as paper. The beef slices are cut this thin.

半熟：只熟一半，還帶粉紅、很嫩。 宴席、辦桌：有很多道菜的大餐；府城食府要先訂位。

half-done: Cooked only halfway, still pink and tender. banquet: A big feast with many dishes. Book ahead at Fu-cheng Restaurant.

實景照片

Photos on site

排隊買蜜餞 Lining up for candied fruit

安平老街上的蜜餞老店，假日門口常排起長長的人龍。左邊是 1886 年創業的林永泰興，右邊也是賣蜜餞的老店。安平的蜜餞有甜、酸、鹹三種滋味，是遊客最愛帶回家的伴手禮。

On Anping Old Street, crowds line up outside the old candied fruit shops on weekends. The shop on the left, Lin Yong Tai Xing, has been selling since 1886. Anping candied fruit can be sweet, sour or salty, and it is a favorite gift to take home.
